caption: Kusto Query Language reads top to bottom: table name first, then each piped operator refines the data in order.
SQL states what you want first (SELECT) and works backward to how to get it — the opposite order from KQL.

steps.sub: KQL pipes left to right; SQL is declarative and doesn't match execution order

steps.sub: KQL queries a Log Analytics workspace; SQL queries a relational database
